caveats: Requires the Claude Code CLI (claude) installed and signed in on the daemon host.
Each side question sends the agent's conversation to Anthropic through Claude Code, whatever the agent's provider.
It cannot reuse the agent's prompt cache, so each side question pays for up to about 100,000 characters of context.
On phones the answer is one tap away in a composer pill, since plugins cannot open overlays.
Side threads live in daemon memory, so a daemon restart or plugin reload clears them.
